fact: On 2 November an IMF/AFRITAC mission opened to support modernisation of the tax directorate and the SIGREF integrated tax revenue system, with the vice-minister citing operators using several tax numbers and the lack of fully integrated computer systems.
title: El FMI y AFRITAC inician una misión de asistencia técnica en el Ministerio de Hacienda para impulsar la modernización de la Administración Tributaria
